filename.Description: Path to the NIfTI file relative to the root inside the PROJECT (BIDS dataset) directory, with no leading periods or slashes.

acq_time.Description: Acquisition time of the scan, taken from the AcquisitionTime field of the file's accompanying JSON sidecar. Empty when the field or sidecar is absent.

series_number.Description: DICOM study series number, taken from the SeriesNumber field of the file's accompanying JSON sidecar. Empty when the field or sidecar is absent.

dimensions.Description: Image array shape as read by nibabel, given as x-joined dimension sizes and always including the 4th (time) dimension even when it is 1 (e.g. 256x256x170x1).

size_bytes.Description: Size of the NIfTI file on disk, in bytes.

bids_name.Description: The portion of the file basename between the sub-<label>_ses-<label>_ prefix and the .nii.gz extension.

rename.Description: Free-text field for an end-user to record a corrected bids_name when the file needs renaming. Empty by default.

recommend_for_use.Description: Whether the file is recommended for use. Empty until reviewed by an end-user.

Levels.TRUE: The file is recommended for use.
Levels.FALSE: The file is not recommended for use.

complete.Description: Whether the file was acquired at its complete, as-intended length. Empty until reviewed by an end-user.

usable.Description: Whether the file is usable at all. Empty until reviewed by an end-user.

qc_rating.Description: Acquisition quality-control rating. Empty until reviewed by an end-user.

rating_reason.Description: Free-text reason for the qc_rating, open to any string of any length. Empty by default.

qc_notes.Description: Free-text notes about the quality control not captured by other fields, open to any string of any length. Empty by default.

participant_id.Description: BIDS participant identifier (sub-<label>) parsed from the filename.

session_id.Description: BIDS session identifier (ses-<label>) parsed from the filename.

datatype.Description: BIDS datatype, taken from the name of the file's parent directory (e.g. anat, func, dwi, fmap).

task.Description: The task-<label> entity parsed from the filename, including the task- prefix (e.g. task-rest). Empty when the entity is absent.

acquisition.Description: The acq-<label> entity parsed from the filename, including the acq- prefix (e.g. acq-highres). Empty when the entity is absent.

echo.Description: The echo-<index> entity parsed from the filename, including the echo- prefix (e.g. echo-1). Empty when the entity is absent.

run.Description: The run-<index> entity parsed from the filename, including the run- prefix (e.g. run-2). Empty when the entity is absent.

suffix.Description: BIDS suffix, the portion of the basename after the last underscore and before the extension. Never empty.
